tests: Verify per-vote nominal counts, four categories, duplicate normalized names, per-date group changes without using as identity proof
Inspect fields of active vs discharged including FECHAALTA,FECHABAJA,FECHACONDICIONPLENA, count missing/invalid/mismatched chronology
